home.heroLead: Gopalan AI measures your cow or buffalo, scores its body condition and recognises the breed. Then it helps you plan feeding and reminds you what's due.
home.step1Text: Stand beside the animal with the printed 20 cm marker next to it.
home.step2Text: The AI places the body points. Drag any orange point that's off.
home.step3Text: Body condition score, breed, measurements and what to do next.
home.f1Text: A consistent 1–5 score in 0.25 steps, explained in plain words.
home.f2Text: 16 Indian cattle and buffalo breeds, or an honest "not sure".
home.f3Text: The lowest-cost mix of the feeds you have that meets your animal's needs.
home.f4Text: Feeding, vaccination, deworming, breeding dates and check-ups.

analyze.title: Analyze my animal
analyze.markerText: Stand it beside the animal, facing you, at the same distance. It turns pixels into centimetres.
analyze.sideHint: Whole animal in frame, side-on, good light
analyze.extraHint: Top and back photos add rump and hip widths for a better score.
analyze.analyzing: Analyzing… this takes a few seconds
analyze.errorService: The analysis service isn't reachable. Check your connection and try again.
analyze.errorGeneric: Something went wrong. Please try again.
analyze.noAnimalText: Take the photo from the side with the whole animal in the frame, in good light.
analyze.dragHint: Drag a point to move it. Arrow keys move the selected point.
analyze.checkHint: Please check: drag it to the right spot
analyze.okHint: Looks right · drag only if it is off

advice.Very thin: Very thin. Increase energy and protein feed, check for worms or illness, and ask a vet if it doesn't improve.
advice.Thin: A little thin. Give a bit more energy feed and check again in 2–3 weeks.
advice.Ideal: Good condition. Keep the current feeding and check again next month.
advice.Fat: A little fat. Reduce concentrate feed slightly and keep the animal moving.
advice.Obese: Too fat. Reduce concentrate feed and talk to a vet, especially before calving.

analyze.notCalibrated: Estimated from body shape; not yet checked against expert scores.
analyze.breedUnsure: Not sure from this photo. Is it one of these?
analyze.breedUnavailable: Breed check isn't available right now.
analyze.retakeWithMarker: Retake with the marker for centimetres
analyze.saveSoon: Saving to “My animals” is coming next.

marker.title: Print the marker
marker.intro: The marker is a black-and-white square of known size. Beside the animal, it lets the app measure in centimetres.
marker.a4: 15 cm · fits A4 or Letter paper
marker.a3: 20 cm · A3 paper or a print shop
marker.tip1: Print at 100% (“Actual size”), not “Fit to page”.
marker.tip2: Measure the black square with a ruler: it must be exactly {size} cm wide. Choose the same size in the app.
marker.tip3: Glue it on cardboard so it stays flat. Keep the white border around it.
marker.tip4: Stand it beside the animal, facing the camera, at the same distance as the animal.
